Christopher R. Hansen increased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 20.65% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp bought 62,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 364,023 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $58.17M, up from 301,723 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $555.94B market cap company. The stock increased 1.57% or $2.96 during the last trading session, reaching $192.06. About 8.35 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
